identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety Study of Aprepitant Injection for Prevention of Post-operative Nausea and Vomiting
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, Multi-center Phase III Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Aprepitant Injection(QLG2174) in the Prevention of Post-operative Nausea and Vomiting

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The goal of this Interventional study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of Aprepitant Injection(QLG2174) for preventing PONV in Chinese patients.

interventions.name: Aprepitant Injection
interventions.description: Before anesthesia induction, 4.4ml(32mg） was given by a single intravenous injection, which was completed within 30 seconds

interventions.name: Aprepitant Injection Placebo
interventions.description: Before anesthesia induction, 4.4ml was given by a single intravenous injection, which was completed within 30 seconds

primaryOutcomes.measure: Complete response (CR) rates over 24 hours after the end of surgery
primaryOutcomes.description: Complete response (defined as no emetic episodes and no use of rescue therapy
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 0-24 hours after the end of surgery
